Air Commando Development Center Mission The Air Commando Development Center employs Special Operations Forces peculiar training, resources, and advanced technologies to provide Air Commandos the skills they require to compete and win in all-domain, full-spectrum joint operations. Vision Air Force Special Operations Command's Center of Excellence develops Air Commandos through deliberate Mission Ready Airmen and Institutional Force Development opportunities to deliver credible, adaptable Airmen that thrive in strategic competition and conflict for the Joint Force. Priorities Development of Air Commandos for Mission Sustainment Teams, Special Operations Task Units, Special Operations Task Groups, Joint Task Forces and Institutional Development courses. Utilize Air Commando attributes, competencies, and joint functions; execute tasks and responsibilities in support of AFSOC Mission Ready Airmen and Institutional Development per the direction and priorities of the AFSOC commander at the appropriate development level. Advise the AFSOC commander on current and future support requirements and resourcing necessary to meet AFSOC’s development requirements.
